features: Suite-wide options select one native runner invocation rather than isolated per-file invocations. Shard partition, global bail, seeded order, concurrency/shared realm and coverage controls pass; shard/order controls match direct native execution.

A suite journal retains one invocation and a hashed, deduplicated source inventory separately from observed cases. Sources are checked again after execution. Excluded or bail-stopped files receive no passing credit.
Native case metadata includes terminal counters, allowing strict validation of bail exits without a normal console summary. Public JUnit retains the pinned format.
Native option parsing distinguishes corpus file positionals from option values before path rewriting.
limitations: The coordinated route covers common-root registered suites for the tested options. Mixed roots/targets, prepared subset/vendor integration, script-mode, parallel/isolate/changed options, reporter overrides, complete configuration/cwd and all-platform semantics remain open in #876.
The scoped nine original files retain #874: 62 passing cases, three process checks, one failure/failed file and 40 filtered cases. This is not a green full suite.
Initial validator fixture/identifier and compiler iterator/scope errors are retained. No original assertion or snapshot was modified.

HTTPS accepted-socket receiver/error/lifecycle/reload remain open in #875/#532. Previously excluded constructor/Deno regressions were not rerun. Full Bun suite, #872 and Release/ASAN/all-platform coverage remain open under #66.
